tests.scenario: Valid launch and immediate meditation guidance
steps: Launch the Calm app
Verify the app's main screen loads
Start a new meditation session
tests.expected_result: The meditation session guidance begins within 30 seconds of launching the app

tests.scenario: Edge case: App launch and meditation guidance on slower devices
steps: Simulate a slower device by throttling the CPU
Launch the Calm app
Verify the app's main screen loads
Start a new meditation session
tests.expected_result: The meditation session guidance begins within 30 seconds of launching the app, even on slower devices

tests.scenario: Valid launch with immediate meditation session
steps: Launch Calm app
Wait for 30 seconds
Verify the app is guiding the user through a meditation session
tests.expected_result: The app starts guiding the user through a meditation session within 30 seconds of launch

tests.scenario: Edge case: App launch and meditation session start at 29 seconds
steps: Launch Calm app
Record the timestamp when the app launches
Wait until 29 seconds have passed since launch
Verify the app is guiding the user through a meditation session
tests.expected_result: The app starts guiding the user through a meditation session at or before 30 seconds after launch

tests.scenario: Valid meditation session selection screen load within 3 seconds
steps: Launch the Calm app
Ensure the app is updated to the latest version
Tap on the 'Meditate' button
tests.expected_result: The meditation session selection screen loads within 3 seconds

tests.scenario: Verify 90% of requests load within 3 seconds
steps: Simulate 100 requests to load the meditation session selection screen
Measure the load time for each request
Calculate the percentage of requests that load within 3 seconds
tests.expected_result: At least 90% of requests load the meditation session selection screen within 3 seconds

tests.scenario: Load meditation library within 3 seconds
steps: Launch the Calm app
Navigate to the meditation library section
Measure the time taken for the library to load
tests.expected_result: The meditation library loads within 3 seconds for 95% of requests

tests.scenario: Verify loading time for repeated requests
steps: Launch the Calm app 100 times
Navigate to the meditation library section for each launch
Measure the time taken for the library to load for each request
tests.expected_result: At least 95 out of 100 requests load the meditation library within 3 seconds

tests.scenario: Validate daily meditation session duration
steps: Launch the Calm app
Navigate to the meditation sessions section
Select the daily meditation session option
tests.expected_result: The daily meditation session lasts no longer than 10 minutes

tests.scenario: Verify daily meditation session duration display
steps: Launch the Calm app
Navigate to the meditation sessions section
Select the daily meditation session option
Check the session duration display
tests.expected_result: The session duration is clearly displayed and is 10 minutes or less

tests.scenario: Validate daily meditation session duration for a new user
steps: Launch the Calm app
Navigate to the daily meditation session section
Start a new daily meditation session
tests.expected_result: The meditation session lasts between 8-10 minutes

tests.scenario: Validate daily meditation session duration for 10 consecutive days
steps: Launch the Calm app
Navigate to the daily meditation session section
Complete 10 consecutive daily meditation sessions
Record the duration of each session
tests.expected_result: At least 9 out of 10 sessions last between 8-10 minutes

tests.scenario: Validate free meditation sessions for non-subscribed users
steps: Launch the Calm app
Verify the user is not logged in or subscribed to the premium service
Navigate to the meditation sessions section
tests.expected_result: The app displays at least 30 free meditation sessions available for the user

tests.scenario: Verify the limit of free meditation sessions per month for non-subscribed users
steps: Launch the Calm app
Verify the user is not logged in or subscribed to the premium service
Access and complete 30 free meditation sessions
Navigate back to the meditation sessions section
tests.expected_result: The app indicates that no more free meditation sessions are available for the month or limits access to additional sessions

tests.scenario: Validate free meditation sessions for non-subscribed users
steps: Launch the Calm app
Verify the user is not logged in or subscribed to the premium service
Navigate to the meditation session library
tests.expected_result: The user can access at least 30 free meditation sessions

tests.scenario: Verify the 30 free meditation session limit for non-subscribed users
steps: Launch the Calm app
Verify the user is not logged in or subscribed to the premium service
Access 30 free meditation sessions
Attempt to access a 31st free meditation session
tests.expected_result: The user is prevented from accessing the 31st free meditation session and is prompted to subscribe to the premium service

tests.scenario: Validate guided meditation session with calming nature sound
steps: Launch the Calm app
Navigate to the meditation session selection menu
Select a guided meditation session with a calming nature sound (e.g., ocean waves)
Start the meditation session
Verify the session includes a calming nature sound
tests.expected_result: The meditation session includes a calming nature sound (e.g., ocean waves) and lasts for at least 20 minutes.

tests.scenario: Validate meditation session duration
steps: Launch the Calm app
Navigate to the meditation session selection menu
Select a guided meditation session with a calming nature sound (e.g., ocean waves)
Start the meditation session
Monitor the session duration
tests.expected_result: The meditation session lasts for at least 20 minutes.

tests.scenario: Validate the number of guided meditation sessions
steps: Launch the Calm app
Navigate to the meditation library section
Count the number of guided meditation sessions available
tests.expected_result: The app displays at least 20 guided meditation sessions

tests.scenario: Validate the duration and variety of guided meditation sessions
steps: Launch the Calm app
Navigate to the meditation library section
Select 5 random guided meditation sessions
Verify the duration and theme of each session
Verify the availability of various soothing sounds
tests.expected_result: All selected sessions have durations between 5 and 30 minutes, and there is a variety of themes and soothing sounds
